================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YA AFTER EFFECTS - SWINTSHWA
Version 9.2.8  -  Nhlangula 2026
================================================================================

Panel sweswi yi vulavula TINDZIMI TA 132, ku ni TI-THEME TINTSHWA TA DEMON SLAYER leti nga ni banga leri
tsemaka tibututu leti u ti tshikelelaka, ni swilulamiso switsongo swa layout ni swa Windows.

RHANGELA U NGA SI SUNGULA
- Kumisa ehenhla ka version ya wena ya sweswi hi ZXP installer ya wena yo tolovelekile, kutani
  sunguta After Effects kan'we.
- Swilulamiso swa wena, theme, ti-preset ni ti-expression leti hlayisiweke swi ta hlayisiwa.

LEYINTSHWA: PANEL HI TINDZIMI TA 132
- Flex Swilulamiso > RIRIMI sweswi swi kombisa tindzimi ta 132, ni bokisi ro lavisisa. Hlawula yin'we
  kutani panel hinkwayo yi cinca: ti-tab, tibututu, ti-tooltip, mahungu.
- Ririmi rin'wana ni rin'wana ri hundzuluxiwile hi AI ku suka eka panel ya Xinghezi, a hi rito
  hi rito. Mavito lawa u ma vonaka eka puroyeke ya wena (mavito ya layer, mavito ya effect) ma
  tshama hi Xinghezi leswaku ma ya emahlweni ma fambisana ni After Effects.
- Popup ya "swintshwa" na yona yi hundzuluxiwile, ku sunguriwa eka release leyi.

LEYINTSHWA: TI-THEME TA DEMON SLAYER
- Flex Swilulamiso > THEME SELECTOR yi ni ntlawa lowuntshwa wa DEMON SLAYER wa ti-theme ta 11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen na Kokushibo.
- Fambisa mouse ehenhla ka panel kutani xiphemu xa theme xi yi landzela: mati, ndzilo,
  lightning, butterflies, petals, mist ni swin'wana. Loko mouse yi yima,
  xi nyamalala hi ku nonoka.
- Klika bututu kutani banga ra xiphemu lexi ri yi tsema. Loko u khoma bututu ya ximatsi
  ri ya emahlweni ri tsema; loko u ri khoma ku ringana tisekoni ta 2.5, yi ta explode.
- Yi endliwe leswaku a yi tiki: ti-effect ti tirha ntsena loko u fambisa mouse kumbe u klika,
  kutani ti hunguta ku tika ka tona hi voxe eka makhomphyuta lama nonokaka. Veka AMBIENT EFFECTS eka OFF
  eka Theme Selector leswaku u hlayisa mivala ntsena.

SWI CINCIWILE: TIBUTUTU TA FLAT EKA THEME HINKWAYO
- Tibututu leti tirhaka ni leti kulu eka ti-theme ta mivala a ti tlhela ti tirhisa shaded gradient
  ku suka le henhla ku ya le hansi. Ti ni muvala wun'we wa flat ni glow yo olova, hikwalaho
  ti vonaka ti basile naswona ti hlayeka ku antswa.

SWI LULAMISIWILE
- Khadi ya laisensi ni popup ya "swintshwa" a swi kota ku pfuriwa yin'wana ehenhla ka yin'wana.
  Sweswi a swi tlhela swi hlangana, naswona UPDATE badge a yi tlhela yi funengeta tibututu
  leti nga le henhla ka panel.
- Eka UI SCALE 125% ni 150%, mafasitere man'wana (ku fana ni Flex Swilulamiso) ma kota ku leha ku tlula
  panel, hikwalaho bututu ya wona ya ku pfala yi nyamalala. Sweswi fasitere rin'wana ni rin'wana
  ri nghena eka vukulu hinkwabyo.
- Windows: AutoCaptions a yi kota ku vula "NVIDIA DRIVER YI DYUHALE NGOPFU EKA GPU CAPTIONS" eka
  ti-khadi ni ti-driver letintshwa (RTX 40 ni 50 series). Sweswi yi hlaya ku seketela ka CUDA ka
  driver hi ndlela leyinene kutani yi tirhisa GPU ya wena.

LESWI NGA CINCIWANGIKI
- Ku nyika laisensi, activation ni link yin'wana ni yin'wana swi tirha hi ndlela yin'we hi ku fana ni khale.
- Ti-tab hinkwato letin'wana ni switirhisiwa swi tirha hi ndlela yin'we hi ku fana eka 9.2.7.
================================================================================

FLEX ULTIMATE YA PREMIERE PRO - SWINTSHWA
Version 2.2.8  -  Nhlangula 2026

Ti-caption ta CAPTION STACK sweswi i ti-template leti hlelekaka ta Motion Graphics hi editor ya
ntiyiso, ku ni AUDIO STUDIO leyintshwa ni HLAYA BEATS YA AUDIO, panel yi vulavula tindzimi ta 132,
UI SCALE yi fikile eka ULTIMATE, naswona ku ni TI-THEME TINTSHWA TA DEMON SLAYER.

RHANGELA U NGA SI SUNGULA
- Kumisa ehenhla ka version ya wena ya sweswi hi ZXP installer ya wena yo tolovelekile, kutani
  sunguta Premiere Pro kan'we.
- Swilulamiso swa wena, theme ni ti-preset swi ta hlayisiwa.

LEYINTSHWA: CAPTION STACK - TI-CAPTION LETI HLELEKAKA (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Ti-caption sweswi ti vekiwa tanihi ti-template leti hlelekaka ta Motion Graphics (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, leyi nga default leyintshwa eka Premiere Pro 2026). Endzhaku ko veka,
  cinca rito rihi na rihi, font, muvala, vukulu, ndhawu, glow, outline, box,
  animation kumbe nkarhi eka Essential Graphics panel ya Premiere.
- Output > SWIFANISO yi ha veka rito rin'wana ni rin'wana tanihi xifaniso lexi fanaka hi ku hetiseka,
  loko u swi rhandza.
- Ti-template ti taka ni panel. A ku na nchumu wo kuhlayisa.

LEYINTSHWA: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview sweswi yi kombisa frame ya ntiyiso ya vhidiyo ya wena ehansi ka caption yin'wana ni yin'wana.
- Drag caption leswaku u yi fambisa, tirhisa khona leswaku u cinca vukulu ni dot ya le henhla
  leswaku u yi rotate, double-click eka rito leswaku u ri hlela. CAPTION HINKWAYO yi fambisa marito hinkwawo
  swin'we, RITO RIN'WE yi fambisa rito rin'we ntsena.
- Hlawula loko ku cinca ku tirha eka ti-caption hinkwato kumbe eka caption leyi ntsena, kutani
  hlayisa ti-layout ta wena leswaku u ti tirhisa nakambe.
- Ti-look tintshwa ta GLOW ta 10: Xibanzu lexikulu, Bounce Lime, Switswiti, Ku chavisa, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow na Swinene.

LEYINTSHWA: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Hlawula audio clip, hlawula effect kutani u tshikelela TIRHISA. Hinkwaswo swi tirha
  eka khomphyuta ya wena.
- Ti-preset ta klika yin'we ta 30: Underwater, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse ni swin'wana. Hlanganisa
  ti-effect to tala hilaha u lavaka hakona, ti hlela nakambe kumbe u veka yin'we eka OFF.
- Reverb yi hlayisa ntsila wa yona: mpfumawulo wu ya emahlweni ku tlula makumu ya clip, naswona
  yi vekiwa hi ndlela leyi nga ta endla leswaku ku nga tsariwi nchumu ehenhla eka timeline ya wena.
- Switirhisiwa: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  na Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER yi avanyisa risimu eka vocals ni muzik (kumbe ti-stem ta 4). Yi kuhlayisa
  modele ya yona kan'we ro sungula kutani yi ku vutisa rhanga.
- PREVIEW yi ku pfumelela ku yingisa tisekoni ta 8 hi switch ya Original / Processed. Mbuyelo wu va eka
  audio track leyi nga tirhisiwiki, kutani clip ya wena ya ku sungula yi miyetisiwa,
  a yi herisiwi nikatsongo.

LEYINTSHWA: HLAYA BEATS YA AUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > HLAYA BEATS YA AUDIO)
- Hlawula muzik clip eka timeline kutani u tshikelela HLAYA BEATS: Flex yi kuma ti-beat
  kutani yi engetela ti-marker ta sequence eka tona, leswaku ti-cut ta wena ti fambelana
  ni muzik hi ku hetiseka.
- Hlawula hits HINKWAYO, KICKS kumbe SNARES, veka sensitivity, kutani u veka marker eka beat yin'wana ni yin'wana
  kumbe eka beat yin'wana ni yin'wana ya 2 kumbe ya 4.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS yi basisa ntsena ti-marker leti Flex yi ti engeteleke. Yi tirha
  eka khomphyuta ya wena.
